<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Kirin Echo Chime](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3260)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Catalyst" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=791" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 118

**Price** 5 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) (add 1 action)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The echo of [kirin's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1207) song can be captured within this small glass chime, which shatters and calls up a meandering breeze of its own when rung. Adding this catalyst to a [_gust of wind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1550) spell causes any flying creatures that would be pushed by the spell's effects to be pushed 30 feet in a direction of your choice, rather than 30 feet in the direction of the spell.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
